name: Haiti
description: Haiti from the Taíno and Saint-Domingue to the only successful slave revolution, independence in 1804, the Duvaliers and the earthquake of 2010.

checkpoints.name: Saint-Domingue
checkpoints.note: Columbus landed in 1492, and the Taíno died out. France's Saint-Domingue grew rich on sugar worked by enslaved Africans.

checkpoints.name: Revolution and independence
checkpoints.note: The enslaved rose in 1791 and won. Haiti became independent in 1804, the first black republic.

checkpoints.name: Occupation and dictators
checkpoints.note: The United States occupied Haiti from 1915 to 1934. The Duvaliers ruled from 1957 to 1986.

checkpoints.name: Democracy and crisis
checkpoints.note: Aristide was elected in 1990. Coups, the earthquake of 2010, the killing of a president and gang rule followed.
